title: Apply criterion kinds and automation policy without executions
preconditions: A disposable fixture has accepted criteria, positive/negative/edge case definitions and manual/automated variants.

steps.action: Inspect the fixture accepted criterion with positive coverage and no explicit policy.
steps.expected_result: The positive kind is covered under the default policy.

steps.action: Author and supersede a current exact-criterion policy to require positive, negative and edge; separately inspect the policy fixture with positive absent and negative/edge present.
steps.expected_result: The stored current policy retains all three kinds; the report marks positive missing and negative/edge covered independently.

steps.action: In separate no-policy fixtures, supply equivalent manual, hybrid and automated positive cases.
steps.expected_result: All three automation modes are permitted by default.

steps.action: In separate fixtures, create each nonempty subset of positive, negative and edge kinds, linked to the exact criterion revision; supply all required definitions.
steps.expected_result: Every chosen subset is retained and every required kind is reported covered independently.

expected_result: Apply criterion kinds and automation policy without executions.
